question: Six friends - A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing away from the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). F is an immediate neighbour of both B and C. D is sitting second to the right of B. A is sitting to the immediate right of D. Who among the following is sitting to the second to the left of F?
